source: LASP LISIRD nrl2_tsi (NRLTSI2 model composite, monthly)
note: Monthly composite total solar irradiance at 1 AU. Points past the official monthly composite's cutoff are a monthly average of the near-real-time daily feed, so the whole series stays one point per calendar month. If latest_date lags today by more than ~6 weeks, LASP's near-real-time feed likely has a gap -- the tool should label the reading as 'latest available' rather than 'live'.
